versions.changelog:
- Migrated SKILL.md metadata format from YAML front matter to slug/name/version/author fields.
- Removed "metadata" and "keywords" fields, consolidated information.
- No changes to core logic or functionality.

- Improved task detection logic: now scans both in_progress.md and the skills directory.
- Provides reminders when unfinished tasks are detected, suggesting next steps.
- Added detailed usage instructions and safety boundaries. No automatic actions will be performed beyond notification.
- New check_progress.py script outputs incomplete items for Agent review.
